title: Pretend-money pick schema (E1, owner H, gate G5)
description: One row per pick. Append-only: rows are inserted once and never edited or deleted. Revisions are NEW rows with `supersedes` pointing at the id they replace. Resolution (1/0) is filled in post-resolution only and can happen exactly once. Claims whose outcome is already known must not be logged here.

id.description: Sequential pick id, assigned at insert time.

ts.description: UTC ISO8601 timestamp recorded BEFORE the trade (pre-resolution). Never backfilled.

tier.description: Risk tier. One book per tier; agents compete inside a tier only (E3).

agent.description: Agent that submitted the pick (Hermes / Copilot / Zoo / Kilo / AG / AI panel).

instrument.description: Ticker / instrument identifier, normalised to a common index convention.

claim.description: The thesis being bet on, in the agent's own words (not a model echo).

entry_price.description: Price at entry, aligned to a common index before combining with other picks.

kill_rule.description: Pre-registered kill rule. A pick that hits its kill closes as a loss even if it later recovers (E6).

trigger_level.description: For stop_loss: price level that triggers the kill (loss is booked immediately).

max_hold_days.description: For time_based: maximum holding period in days before the pick is closed flat.

git_hash.description: Git commit sha of the code/agent that produced the pick, for provenance (E2).

status.description: open = live position; closed = resolved (1 win / 0 loss); killed = hit its kill rule and booked as a loss; superseded = replaced by a newer row.

supersedes.description: Id of the pick this row replaces. Non-null only for revisions; edits in place are forbidden (E7). Null for original rows.

resolution.description: 1 = win, 0 = loss. Filled in post-resolution, exactly once, never overwritten. Null while open/killed/superseded.

resolved_at.description: UTC ISO8601 of when resolution was stamped. Null while unresolved.

realized_bp.description: Realised P&L in basis points on notional. Flat day (no price move) = 0.0 bp (E2). Populated on close/kill.

mark_to_market_price.description: Latest weekly mark-to-market price (E2). Flat day = 0.0% change.

mark_to_market_ts.description: UTC ISO8601 of the last weekly mark-to-market update.

example_record.claim: Post-FOMC drift continues into the close; 60-day PEAD-style drift is dead for large caps post-2006 (Martineau 2022, C3-verified), so this is an intraday mean-reversion bet, not PEAD.
